full_judgment: 23. Dr. Zahir submits that the MV Hawai Splendour was arrested in Admiralty Suit No. 33 of 1995 and security was duly given to answer the decree if so passed against her. But in Admiralty Suit No. 13 of 1996 MV Mauro D'Alesio could not have been arrested as she left shortly after the arrest and no securities could be obtained from MV Mauro D'Alesio either in the cross-claim made by MV Hawai Splendour in Admiralty Suit No. 33 of 1995 or in Admiralty Suit No. 13 of 1996.
